title: UN Commission findings on Israeli military operations in Gaza
affected_population: Palestinian civilians in the Gaza Strip
summary: A UN Commission of Inquiry made factual and legal findings concerning Israeli authorities' and security forces' conduct in Gaza through 31 December 2023.
claim: For the period 7 October through 31 December 2023, the Independent International Commission of Inquiry found that Israeli authorities were responsible for war crimes including starvation as a method of warfare, murder or wilful killing, intentionally directing attacks against civilians and civilian objects, forcible transfer, sexual violence, torture, and cruel or inhuman treatment; it also found crimes against humanity of extermination and gender persecution.
legal_characterization: War-crime and crime-against-humanity findings by a UN commission of inquiry; not a final judicial determination of state or individual criminal responsibility.
source_organization: United Nations Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and Israel
source_title: Report of the Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and Israel
source_quote: The Commission finds that the immense numbers of civilian casualties in Gaza and widespread destruction of civilian objects and infrastructure were the inevitable result
verification_notes: Verified against the report's conclusions and its express temporal scope ending 31 December 2023 (para. 2). The Commission applied a reasonable-grounds standard described in paragraph 6. The list in this record follows paragraph 105 and is attributed only to the Commission, not characterized as a court judgment.
